rows.label: tlk41200123_02_msg0001
rows.name:
My teacher taught me something
great the other day.

rows.label: tlk41200123_02_msg0002
rows.name:
The longer a Driver and Blade are
together, the stronger they get!

rows.label: tlk41200123_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Drivers earn a Blade's trust by
fighting together and completing
requests.

rows.label: tlk41200123_02_msg0004
rows.name:
In turn, when a Blade grows
and gets stronger, the
Driver's spirit grows too!

rows.label: tlk41200123_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Their growth is linked!
That's what I was told!

rows.label: tlk41200123_02_msg0006
rows.name:
When I become a Driver, I have to
make sure I get along with my Blade.
